Requirement.text: The mission shall acquire multispectral images of agricultural regions at 30 m ground sampling distance from a 500 km sun-synchronous orbit.
The mission shall operate for at least 2 years in orbit.
The spacecraft shall comply with the 3U CubeSat design specification and deorbit within 25 years.
The spacecraft shall point the imager to a ground target with an accuracy better than 0.5 deg (3 sigma).
The spacecraft shall downlink at least 800 MB of payload data per day.
The spacecraft shall provide a positive power balance in all nominal operating modes over one orbit.
All units shall remain within their operational temperature limits in hot and cold cases.
The spacecraft mass shall not exceed 4.0 kg.
The spacecraft shall survive a total ionising dose of 10 krad(Si) without loss of function.
The spacecraft shall withstand the launch vehicle random vibration qualification levels.
The spacecraft shall store at least 8 GB of payload data on board.
The solar arrays shall generate at least 7.5 W orbit-average power at end of life.
The battery shall provide 30 Wh usable energy with depth of discharge below 30 percent.
The power distribution unit shall provide latch-up protected 3.3 V and 5 V regulated buses.
The battery temperature shall be kept above 0 degC during charging.
The EPS shall keep the spacecraft unpowered until deployment switch release.
The ADCS shall determine attitude with an accuracy better than 0.1 deg (3 sigma).
The ADCS shall control attitude with an accuracy better than 0.4 deg (3 sigma).
The ADCS shall detumble the spacecraft from 10 deg/s to below 0.5 deg/s within 3 orbits.
The ADCS shall support sun-pointing safe mode for battery charging.
The ADCS shall provide orbit position knowledge better than 50 m from GNSS.
The X-band transmitter shall provide a downlink data rate of at least 50 Mbps.
The UHF transceiver shall provide telemetry and telecommand at 9.6 kbps.
The X-band link budget shall close with at least 3 dB margin at 10 deg elevation.
The UHF antenna shall deploy reliably after a 30 minute post-separation delay.
The on-board computer shall provide 16 GB of non-volatile mass memory.
The on-board computer shall recover from single event upsets via watchdog reset within 10 s.
The flight software shall support in-orbit software update with rollback.
The flight software shall time-tag images with an accuracy better than 1 ms (UTC).
The flight software shall autonomously enter safe mode after 72 h without ground contact.
The structure first natural frequency shall be above 100 Hz.
The primary structure mass shall not exceed 0.45 kg.
The structure rails shall conform to the 3U deployer interface dimensions.
The thermal design shall keep the battery between 0 degC and 40 degC.
The thermal design shall keep the imager detector below 25 degC during acquisition.
Survival heaters shall be thermostatically controlled independent of flight software.
The imager shall provide 30 m ground sampling distance at 500 km altitude.
The imager shall acquire 4 spectral bands between 450 nm and 900 nm.
The imager electronics shall tolerate 10 krad(Si) total ionising dose.
The imager shall compress images losslessly with a ratio of at least 2:1.

Document.title: Power budget analysis
Document.text: Power budget analysis. Orbit-average power generation of the deployable solar wings is 8.1 W at end of life against a consumption of 6.4 W in imaging mode. Battery depth of discharge stays below 25 percent in eclipse.

Document.title: Pointing budget and ADCS design note
Document.text: Pointing budget and ADCS design note. Star tracker noise and reaction wheel jitter dominate the pointing error budget. Sun exclusion angle of the star tracker constrains imaging geometry.

Document.title: X-band link budget
Document.text: X-band link budget. At 10 degree elevation the link margin is 1.8 dB, below the required 3 dB. Antenna gain or ground station G/T must increase.

Document.title: Thermal analysis hot and cold cases
Document.text: Thermal analysis hot and cold cases. In the cold case the battery reaches minus 3 degC without heater. The detector radiator keeps the detector at 21 degC for 8 minute acquisitions.

Document.title: Structural analysis and vibration test plan
Document.text: Structural analysis and vibration test plan. Finite element modal analysis predicts a first mode of 96 Hz with the deployable solar wings stowed, below the 100 Hz requirement.

Document.title: Radiation analysis
Document.text: Radiation analysis. Total ionising dose behind 2 mm aluminium is 6 krad over 2 years. Commercial memory requires scrubbing and latch-up protection.

Document.title: Mass budget
Document.text: Mass budget. Current best estimate is 3.62 kg with 10 percent margin, giving 3.98 kg against the 4.0 kg limit.

Document.title: Flight software architecture
Document.text: Flight software architecture. Dual boot images with golden image fallback. Time synchronisation uses the GNSS pulse per second.

Document.title: Imager optical design report
Document.text: Imager optical design report. Focal length 580 mm with 5.5 micrometre pixels gives 4.7 m at 500 km per pixel before binning; 6x6 binning yields about 30 m.

Document.title: Frequency coordination status
Document.text: Frequency coordination status. The X-band filing is under coordination. The S-band antenna from the previous mission is kept on the bill of materials pending a decision.
